subject.title: Telegram: ForceReply prompt for the argument when an args-requiring command is tapped from the menu with no argument

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in missing-argument prompt contract for native commands, and should Telegram render that contract as ForceReply for commands such as /btw and /steer?
rationale: This is not just a Telegram send tweak: it changes native command semantics and may become command registry, plugin SDK, or portable presentation/action metadata depending on the chosen design.

options.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
options.body: Define a command-level prompt descriptor, enable it only for selected missing-freeform-argument commands, and implement Telegram ForceReply as the channel mapping.

options.title: Keep usage-only behavior
options.body: Leave bare menu taps as usage replies until there is a broader native-command prompt design.

options.title: Prototype Telegram-only allowlist
options.body: Add a short Telegram-local allowlist for known commands, accepting drift risk from shared command metadata and other native surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in prompt metadata
recommendation.body: Define a command-level prompt descriptor, enable it only for selected missing-freeform-argument commands, and implement Telegram ForceReply as the channel mapping.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision is about command registry and native command UX shape, and this person is the clearest routing candidate from merged command-menu history.
